subject: Ecosummit mini-track: slotting, MDF & shared booth coordination
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@atlasdrive.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: AtlasDrive Marketing <marketing@atlasdrive.io>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Ecosummit mini-track partnership proposal

Hi Karthik,

Great meeting you at the edge operators breakfast last week — thanks again for the quick chat about Redwood's latency story. AtlasDrive is running a small regional track at Ecosummit this October (two half-days adjacent to the main show) and we'd love to explore co-hosting a mini-track together.

High-level from our side:
- 3 sessions across two half-days (partners can provide 2 speakers total)
- Shared 10x20 booth directly outside the mini-track room (split staffing)
- MDF request: $20k to cover sponsored content and lead-gen ads
- We handle venue logistics and base promotion; asking partners to commit to content co-promotion and a short demo for the track.

I've attached a short proposal with budget line items and suggested timelines (ecosummit-proposal.pdf). If this looks like something Redwood would be interested in, can we lock a 30–45 minute call to align on ask/responsibilities and quickly sketch a mutual action plan?

Thanks — happy to loop in our ops lead if helpful.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Head of Partnerships | AtlasDrive
--
ecosummit-proposal.pdf (attachment) — 3 pages, high-level budget and timeline
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@atlasdrive.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ecosummit mini-track partnership proposal

Thanks for the note and the proposal, Aisha — appreciate the clear starter doc.

We're interested, and a quick align call makes sense. High-level questions for the call so we can be prepared:
- Can you confirm the MDF spend breakdown (ads vs. on-site materials vs. lead-gen)?
- Are the speaker slots 20 minutes + 5 Q&A or different timing?
- Booth ops: will AtlasDrive staff the booth evenings or do you expect partners to cover specific shifts?
- Any exclusivity clauses (we may have other infra partners attending)?

Suggested times for a sync: Thu Aug 6 09:00–11:00 PT or Fri Aug 7 13:00–15:00 PT. I can invite our field marketing lead (Marissa) and procurement (Rishi) to join — looping them now.

If that works I can calendar invite and add a preliminary mutual action plan to drive decisions.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference

> Thanks for the note and the proposal, Aisha — appreciate the clear starter doc.
> 
> We're interested, and a quick align call makes sense. High-level questions for the call so we can be prepared:
> - Can you confirm the MDF spend breakdown (ads vs. on-site materials vs. lead-gen)?
> - Are the speaker slots 20 minutes + 5 Q&A or different timing?
> - Booth ops: will AtlasDrive staff the booth evenings or do you expect partners to cover specific shifts?
> - Any exclusivity clauses (we may have other infra partners attending)?
>
> Suggested times for a sync: Thu Aug 6 09:00–11:00 PT or Fri Aug 7 13:00–15:00 PT. I can invite our field marketing lead (Marissa) and procurement (Rishi) to join — looping them now.

Thanks Karthik — all good questions. Quick answers before the call:
- MDF $20,000 total: $8k paid media (social + programmatic), $6k on-site collateral/printing, $4k lead-gen form integration & prizes, $2k contingency. We can line-item this in the SOW if you need spend categories.
- Speaker timing: 20 min + 10 min Q&A (we've found slightly longer Q&A increases leads).
- Booth ops: AtlasDrive will cover evenings and primary shifts; asking partners to cover two 2-hour blocks during peak show hours (we'll coordinate schedule).
- No hard exclusivity for infra; we do cap competing vendors in the mini-track (we'll share a short vendor policy).

Attaching speaker bios so we can start drafting session descriptions (atlasdrive-speaker-bios.docx). I'll take Thu Aug 6 09:30 PT if that still works for you — calendar invite coming.

Best,
Aisha
--
atlasdrive-speaker-bios.docx (attachment) — 4 bios
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@atlasdrive.io>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ecosummit mini-track partnership proposal — procurement & SOW notes

Looping in procurement notes and next steps from Redwood side.

Marissa here — quick checklist so we stay on timeline for a September SOW sign: 
- We need a line-itemed SOW (MDF breakdown) and a payment schedule (50% on signature, 50% 30 days before event).
- Redwood legal requires a 60‑day window for any indemnity/insurance review for events; please include your standard exhibitor addendum.
- If AtlasDrive can add co-branded content commitments (two blog posts + one paid post), we can reduce MDF to $12k (we'll cover additional PR spend).
- DocuSign path preferred for quick signature — if you can drop the SOW link we'll route it to finance.

Also Rishi — can you confirm whether we should treat this MDF as marketing expense or co-op (impact on forecasting)? I'll need the input before we lock budget.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@atlasdrive.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Raj Patel <raj@eventworks.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ecosummit mini-track partnership proposal — mutual action plan & next steps

Thanks everyone — good progress. Summarizing agreed actions and owners so we have a single source of truth: 

Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — Ecosummit mini-track
1) AtlasDrive: Share line-itemed SOW with itemized MDF breakdown and exhibitor addendum by Mon Aug 17. (Aisha)
2) Redwood (Marissa): Review SOW/insurance; confirm reduced MDF path if co-branded content is added. Target reply by Wed Aug 19.
3) Redwood (Rishi): Confirm accounting treatment for MDF (marketing vs co-op). Target by Fri Aug 21.
4) AtlasDrive + Redwood: Draft session descriptions and speaker blurbs. Drafts due Mon Aug 24. (Aisha + Karthik)
5) Logistics: Confirm booth staffing schedule and lead-capture form. Raj (EventWorks) to confirm booth dimensions and shipping cutoff by Aug 20.
6) Contract: AtlasDrive to send DocuSign link for SOW (preferred) — Redwood to route to finance and sign when ready.

I've attached a simple tracker so we can toggle owners and dates (co_marketing_map.xlsx). Also adding the event page and our HubSpot reference: HUBSPOT-123456.

If there are no major objections I'll send calendar invites for a working session (60 minutes) next Tue Aug 18 to get the MAP into a shared doc.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
